reviewItem.question: For "CLI-based Injection of Global Context Entries: Kyverno CLI now allows you to dynamically inject global context entries using a Values file", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: Kyverno CLI 1.13.0 adds the ability to inject global context entries during policy evaluation by defining global values (e.g. request.operation) and rule-specific values in a cli.kyverno.io/v1alpha1 Values file (new globalValues field), without modifying GlobalContextEntry resources in the cluster.
